verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments SaaS that processes user and transaction data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis therefore applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy or any training restriction; the items cover payments, wallets, SDKs, PCI-DSS, llms.txt and the MCP server, none of which address this.
